source_clause: PVAL10.) For activation and deactivation, when on the PIN entry popup, grey out the Go button until 4 digits are entered. If Go is pressed while greyed out, play Bonk tone and display the popup “PIN must be 4 digits”.
leaf_desc_037: PVAL10.) For activation and deactivation, when on the PIN entry popup, grey out the Go button until 4 digits are entered. If Go is pressed while greyed out, play Bonk tone and display the popup “PIN must be 4 digits”.
reasoning: 驗證目標：12.10（PVAL10）—— 未滿 4 碼前 Go 鍵變灰；此時按下播 Bonk 並顯示指定 popup。關鍵情境條件：ER4 為對照 —— 輸滿 4 碼後 Go 須可用，否則「未滿時變灰」與「永遠變灰」分不出（§7）。**來源標示（J-12）**：3 碼為測試設置（條文只說「未滿 4 碼」）。為什麼這樣切：兩個結果同屬「未滿 4 碼」此一條件，依 §5.7 併為一條。

tcs.tc_title: Go button greyed out until four digits are entered
tcs.test_item: Go button greyed out until four digits are entered
tcs.pre_conditions:
1. The Valet Mode PIN entry popup is displayed
2. The vehicle is stationary
tcs.test_procedure:
1. Enter three digits and read the Go button
2. Press the Go button while it is greyed out
3. Read the screen and check the tone and the popup
4. Enter a fourth digit and read the Go button
tcs.expected_result:
1. The Go button is greyed out with three digits entered
2. The press is not accepted
3. A Bonk tone is played and the popup “PIN must be 4 digits” is displayed
4. The Go button is available with four digits entered
tcs.priority_basis: Go 鍵之可用性與其提示
